newsitem.title: FRANCE: British woman, son arrested with cocaine at Orly.
newsitem.headline: British woman, son arrested with cocaine at Orly.

text.p: A British mother and her son have been arrested at Paris' Orly airport with 19 kg (nearly 42 lb) of cocaine in their luggage, French customs officials said on Thursday.

The two unnamed Britons were detained on Monday on arrival from Cayenne, French Guiana, on the northeast coast of South America. They were turned over to judicial authorities who will decide whether to press charges.
Customs said the cocaine was concealed in their luggage wrapped in carbon paper and adhesive tape to make it undetectable by x-ray.
